description: Nuka ROCm stack audit, cupy reduction pathology, and the diagonal-lift D-optimization campaign (orders 28/30/32/36/38).

rocm_audit.cupy_wheel: amd_cupy-13.5.1 (from ~/.cache/rocm-wheels/) hard-links libamdhip64.so.7, librocblas.so.5, libhipblaslt.so.1 from /opt/rocm/lib (ROCm 7.2.4)
rocm_audit.rocm10_on_box: /opt/rocm/core-10.0, version 10.0.0, full toolchain (hipcc, amdclang++) + hipBLAS/hipBLASLt/MIOpen gfx1201
rocm_audit.rocm10_cupy_wheels: none published (repo.radeon.com/rocm/manylinux tops at rocm-rel-7.2.4; PyPI amd-cupy is a 0.0.2 stub)

rocm10_hipblas_wide_gemm.note: vs 0.4 ms V100 cuBLAS; GEMM was never the bottleneck

reduction_pathology.fix_effect: order-36 lift pass 42 s -> 5 s on nuka (V100 3 s)

lift_campaign.object: K(D) = [[A, A+D],[A+D, -A]], exact 2^(2n-1)-state Phi via M2=(A+D)@Yt wide-GEMM pass

conclusion: No new finite records. The D=I diagonal lift is the family optimum at all tested orders so far. Nuka ops: two-stage reductions (or hipcc/ROCm10) required for GPU work.
